groups.meta: Antivirus Bounty, tier 7, an Antivirus mod
conditions: Four spent Antivirus or Potency mods transmute into one fully charged mod of that kind.
bonuses: Antivirus and Potency mods drop as public loot off any squadmate's stab, so pubbing tops you up even before your own Coda has spawned.

rows.label: Antivirus mods
rows.note: only 1 of the 8 works on your Coda, so test 3 at once; tradeable, 3 charges each

rows.label: Potency mods
rows.note: dropped by Techrot in any Höllvania mission; also tradeable

groups.meta: Technocyte Coda, Mercy stabs fill the Malware Disinfection meter
conditions: Duets spawn at 25% per mission, +25% per miss, guaranteed on the 4th.
A Duet that stumbles 3 times unstabbed, or a downed squad, flees the encounter.
Potency mods do nothing unless the correct Antivirus is also equipped.
Phases 1 and 3 are hazard-dodging with Transference disabled; in phases 2 and 4 the frontman regenerates until his bandmates are dead.
bonuses: In a squad each Encore drops 1 Live Heartcell, up to 3 with a full squad.

disclosures.title: stage hazards
disclosures.body: Three hits from the stage hazards give Stage Fright: you take double damage and the Coda grows stronger.

disclosures.title: squad Concerts
disclosures.body: Each player's Coda spawns one at a time through an Encore prompt, so the fight repeats for every squadmate.

rows.label: spawn via Exterminate, Hell-Scrub or Legacyte Harvest
rows.note: kill Techrot for a Mixtape, then hack with it

rows.label: find the correct Antivirus
rows.note: all 3 equipped mods are tested at once, no penalty for a wrong guess

rows.label: 100% disinfection
rows.note: a correct stab with 2 Potency mods adds up to 35%; missions alone cap at 95%

rows.label: Technocyte Coda Concert
rows.note: Railjack skirmish, then the four-phase stage fight; Vanquish it for 10-15 Live Heartcells

groups.meta: Batch A, one copy per 4-day rotation
conditions: Coda Mire is Batch A, alongside Coda Hema, Coda Sporothrix, Coda Catabolyst, Coda Pox, Dual Coda Torxica and Coda Motovore; Batch B carries no Coda Mire.
One purchase per weapon per rotation; rotations flip every 4 days at 0:00 UTC.
An empty weapon slot is required before Eleanor will sell to you.

disclosures.title: Valence Fusion toward 60%
disclosures.body: Optional; bank copies first. A 58%+ roll rounds up to 60% on its own; a 52.8%+ roll one fusion reaches 60%. Fusion takes the higher of the two bonuses × 1.1, capped at 60%. Fuse into the copy holding your Forma and Catalyst; the donor's investments, including Elemental Vice, are destroyed. Elemental Vice needs the weapon at rank 40 (5 Forma): 50,000 Hex standing at Eleanor's Rank 5, or a Temporal Archimedea or Nightwave drop.
